proof_candidate_incompleteness_handling.description: Procedures for handling and classifying incomplete proofs in the review pipeline.

incompleteness_classes.handling_rule: Mark as local_only with boundary warning; status cannot exceed incomplete_but_traceable.
Treat as assumption; classify as local_derivation.
Require explicit quantifier trace; block proof_candidate status.
Maintain current status; add wait-lock for machine review.
Add to lexicon_gap_queue; block elevation to formalized.
Permit proof_candidate status with documented scope limits.
